newsitem.title: USA: Brokerages being probed over stocks - official.
newsitem.headline: Brokerages being probed over stocks - official.

text.p: At least 19 small New York City area brokerages have been subpoenaed during the past three weeks in an investigation of possible stock manipulation, the prosecutor in the case said on Thursday.
Assistant New York State attorney general Andrew Kandel said the probe was focusing on "high pressure sales tactics, misrepresentation by brokerage firms and stock manipulation".
Kandel declined to identify the firms, and said it was "too early to say" whether they would be indicted.
He said the investigation was independent of any other probe that any regulatory agency might be conducting.

"It's a very active investigation that has been going on for many months," Kandel said. "It's hard to put a dollar amount on this. It is still being investigated. Some people may not even know they lost money."

The prosecutor said that in New York during the last year, the state attorney-general's office had received more complaints from investors than in any previous year. The increase may be attributed partly to the bull market and the large number of people investing in mutual funds, Kandel said.
